relevant_laws.quote: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Enter a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or origin or destination point on a public street in such a manner that the bus when stopped to load or unload passengers or baggage shall be in a position with the right-hand front wheel of such vehicle not farther than eighteen inches from the curb and the bus approximately parallel to the curb so as not to unduly impede the movement of other vehicular traffic.
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen one-way-road bus loading with following vehicle; non-tour bus, public street and qualifying location remain original-source gated.
